metadata.title: Algeria wilayas and communes (2026 territorial division)

legal_basis.law: Loi n° 26-06 portant découpage territorial (69 wilayas, 1541 communes)
legal_basis.journal_officiel: Journal Officiel de la République Algérienne n° 25, 17 Chaoual 1447 / 5 avril 2026

verification.summary: Headcounts for all JO-cited wilayas match; the 11 new wilayas (59-69) were cross-checked commune-by-commune against JO arts 52 bis 10-20. Residual name differences are listed for review.
verification.notes: Names are transliterations; spelling_variant = likely the same place under a different transliteration, unmatched = requires manual review against the official Arabic JO text.
